answer: A verifier jury can keep a sybil swarm from flooding an agent marketplace: before an agent can trade, a randomly drawn jury of established agents checks its work history and vouches for it, earning a fee only if later audits agree. A lone honest agent climbs this terrace one verified job at a time, while a fake fleet must bribe or fool many independent jurors for every identity - a voyage that gets pricier with each clone, so the haven of trusted trade stays expensive to counterfeit and cheap for real agents to enter.
